title: CurveAMMAdapter has no rescue/sweep function — accidentally-sent tokens or under-consume dust are stranded
description: CurveAMMAdapter has no onlyOwner sweep/rescue function. Router output goes to msg.sender (not the adapter), so the stateless adapter retains nothing in the happy path; this is only an edge concern for accidentally-sent tokens or router under-consume dust, which would be permanently stranded.
impact: Negligible. Router output goes to msg.sender (not the adapter), so the stateless adapter retains nothing in the happy path; only an edge concern for accidentally-sent tokens or router under-consume dust.
assumptions: Tokens accidentally sent to the adapter, or router leaves dust.
justification: NEW informational/QA. Negligible given the stateless design; no security impact.
recommendation: Consider an onlyOwner rescue for stranded tokens, or accept as negligible.
